summary: Iteration #5 audit fix pack (Tiers A/B/C/D) tested. 18/18 backend pytest passing. Frontend: login (email + employee_id), RBAC admin (columns, pending section, create/reset user), expense-vendor-select dropdown, and task-vendor-picker all working. One frontend bug found: pending user renders 'Account Deactivated' copy instead of 'Awaiting Admin Approval'.

ui_bugs.issue: Pending user (approval_status='pending', is_active=false) is rendered as REJECTED. Screen title shows 'ACCOUNT DEACTIVATED / Not on the roster.' instead of 'AWAITING ADMIN APPROVAL / You're on the list.' Root cause: isRejected = approval_status==='rejected' || user.is_active===false in /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.js:51. Since pending users also have is_active=false, both isPending and isRejected are true; ternary in App.js:42/45/48 favours the rejected copy. Fix: isRejected = approval_status==='rejected' || (is_active===false && approval_status!=='pending')

action_items: Fix isRejected logic in /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.js so pending users show the pending-approval copy instead of the deactivated copy.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend AuthContext isRejected boolean over-matches pending users due to is_active=false being reused by both pending & rejected — needs a precedence rule.
Backend approve endpoint takes decision='approve|reject'; the frontend calls /rbac/users/{id}/approve for both actions which is fine but the endpoint name is misleading — consider /decision.

Accounting router mounts /accounts at API root (not under /accounting). Slightly inconsistent with other /accounting/* endpoints — spec calls it /api/accounting/accounts but real path is /api/accounts. Consider aligning.

rca of the issue: AuthContext.js line 51 defines: isRejected = user?.approval_status === 'rejected' || user?.is_active === false. The pending Google-sign-in user has approval_status='pending' AND is_active=false (server sets is_active=false until Admin approves). The OR condition therefore makes isRejected true for pending users, and App.js branches (isRejected ? ... : ...) select the 'ACCOUNT DEACTIVATED / Not on the roster.' copy. Fix: change to isRejected = user?.approval_status === 'rejected' || (user?.is_active === false && user?.approval_status !== 'pending').
